what: The two attacks that were still generic effects (wave and nova, 1,074 Genesis) are drawn from the eyes of each Genesis; the Rare and Epic rarities get their delivery (return, persistent zone); a web page shows any Genesis as its hero card.

rare_deliveries.zone_colour: First capture: the zone left by an expression-eyed hero took the colours of its eyes (a green and white disc). Fixed so a zone takes the colour of its Aura, or green without one; the fix is in the build on port 8083 and was type-checked, not captured again.
rare_deliveries.repeated_lines: In the first run, before ticks were logged, the player's own return skill wrote six action lines in 2.6 s where two were expected; every bot wrote clean pairs. Skill events are raised on predicted frames. A later run with ticks shows it happening: the player's first action is written at tick 674 and again at tick 675, then the second action at tick 701, 26 ticks after. So a corrected prediction writes the same use again one tick apart; the simulation fires two actions. The six lines of the first run are read the same way, without their ticks to prove it.

hero_page.what: web/hero/: number or wallet address in, hero cards out, with career and a top ten. Data generated by tools/web/build_hero_data.py from the roster and from content/genesis-card-text.json, which the Unity roster import now writes.
hero_page.seen: At 390 x 844 (phone emulation) the card of CHOG #1287; at 1100 px the sixteen Genesis of 0x80ef...bb13 read on Monad through the services. No sideways overflow, no console error, no failed request.
hero_page.not_done: Not deployed. The Share button and the 'Use my wallet' button were not exercised (no wallet and no share sheet in the test browser). No preview image for shared links.

tests: 22 Quantum tests (new: named bots enter first), 13 view tests outside Unity, 21 service tests (new: the top list).
limits: inversion (10 Legendary 1:1) is not built: those heroes play like a direct hit and their card says so.
No simulation test steps a return or a zone through its lifetime: both are read from the code and from the logged ticks and damage of one headless match.
The shares (60 and 80 for a return, 50 plus 500 a tick for a zone) are first numbers. A zone applies its Aura at every tick, like the puddle: a hex zone roots again and again.
Not measured on the phone: a burst is eight more draws for half a second, a stare two.
